'''Ferdinando Gliozzi''' ({{IPA|it|ferdiˈnando ʎˈʎɔttsi|lang}}; born 1940)  is a string theorist at the [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare]]. Along with [[David Olive]] and [[Joël Scherk]], he proposed the [[GSO projection]]<ref>
{{cite journal
 |last=Gliozzi
 |first=Ferdinando
 |last2=Scherk
 |first2=Joël
 |author-link2=Joël Scherk
 |last3=Olive
 |first3=David I.
 |date=1977
 |title=Supersymmetry, Supergravity Theories And The Dual Spinor Model
 |url=http://www.slac.stanford.edu/spires/find/hep?j=NUPHA,B122,253
 |journal=[[Nuclear Physics B]]
 |volume=122
 |issue=2
 |pages=253–290
 |bibcode=1977NuPhB.122..253G
 |doi=10.1016/0550-3213(77)90206-1
}}{{dead link|date=December 2016 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref name=polchinski>
{{cite book
 |last=Polchinski |first=Joseph
 |date=1998
 |title=String Theory: Volume 2
 |page=45
 |publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]]
 |isbn=978-0-521-63304-8
}}</ref> to map out the [[tachyon]]ic [[Quantum state vector|states]] in the Neveu–Schwarz sector.<ref name=polchinski/>
